init_script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
touch /tmp/forge-init-running
sleep 4
attempt=0
while [ ! -e /tmp/forge-init-release ]; do
  attempt=$((attempt + 1))
  if [ "$attempt" -ge 200 ]; then exit 1; fi
  sleep 0.1
done
